user.title: Smart Heating
user.description: Set up room-by-room smart heating. Add rooms afterwards via Configure.

heating_settings.title: Boiler, presence and vacation
heating_settings.description: The thermostat that drives the boiler (Smart Heating raises its setpoint to call for heat), the people who count as home, how heading home is detected, the vacation calendar, the low (no demand) and high (demand) thermostat setpoints, Boost and Manual-room override durations, and the bedroom pre-bed warm-up window (used by the bedroom preset when a room is saved).

data.boiler_entity: Boiler thermostat (climate entity that makes the boiler fire)
data.auto_arrival: Detect heading home from the phones' GPS (no zone needed)
data.arrival_entities: Extra heading-home signals (optional; e.g. a switch that is on, or a zone with someone in it)
data.vacation_calendar: Vacation calendar (optional; matching events turn Vacation mode on automatically)
data.vacation_keywords: Vacation keywords in the event title or description (comma-separated; * = every event)

report_settings.title: Gas report settings
report_settings.description: Weekly report on Mondays. Compares m3 per heating-degree-day with the same week last year (needs recorder long-term statistics for both entities).

add_room.title: Add a room
add_room.description:
{reason}

Schedule: one comfort window per line, e.g. `mon,wed,fri 08:00-17:00`, `mon-fri 07:00-09:00` or `daily 06:00-23:00`. Outside the windows the room is at setback.

data.name: Room name
data.manual: Manual room: radiator valve turned by hand, no Zigbee (not for floor heating or open radiators)
data.floor_heating: Floor heating (no TRV; needs a sensor; starts very early)
data.open_radiators: Open radiators (no TRV yet; needs a sensor; stops the boiler once warm)
data.trv_entity: TRV (not needed for manual, floor heating or open radiators)
data.sensor_entity: External temperature sensor (required for floor heating and open radiators)
data.presence_entities: Who is this room for? (optional; no scheduled heating while all of them are away)
data.arrival_entities: Heading-home signal (optional; e.g. a 'near home' zone (active while someone is in it), or a switch that is on. Warms the room early)
data.preset: Schedule preset (used when the schedule below is empty)
data.trv_offset: TRV sensor offset (0 = let the system learn it)
data.compensate_trv: Correct the valve setpoint with the room sensor (only for valves that cannot take an external temperature)
data.window_drop: Open-window drop (maximum; learned lower per room)
data.demand_hysteresis: Room call margin (0 = global setting; keep below the sensor step, e.g. under 0.5 for a 0.5° sensor)

advanced_settings.title: Boiler call and alert thresholds
advanced_settings.description: Debounce and backoff of boiler thermostat writes (cloud rate limits), demand hysteresis, alert thresholds and the Zigbee2MQTT base topic. Alerts can also go to your phone: they are sent once they have lasted the delay, with a message when they are resolved.

data.debounce_minutes: Debounce after a boiler thermostat change
data.backoff_base_minutes: First backoff after a failed write
data.demand_hysteresis: Demand hysteresis (room must be this far below target)
data.trv_settle_minutes: Radiator valve: wait this long after a write before checking it
data.boiler_settle_minutes: Boiler thermostat: wait this long after a write before treating a difference as a manual change
data.boiler_manual_hold_minutes: Boiler thermostat: respect a manual change for
data.outage_after_failures: Boiler thermostat outage after failed writes
data.notify_targets: Also send alerts to (notify services, e.g. your phone's mobile app)
data.notify_delay_minutes: Send to those only after an alert has lasted
data.z2m_base_topic: Zigbee2MQTT base topic (for TRVs that get the room temperature over MQTT)

error.invalid_room: Invalid room: check names, entities, temperatures and schedule.

boost.name: Boost a room
boost.description: Heat a room to its comfort temperature now, for a while.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long (default: the configured Boost duration).

cancel_boost.name: Cancel Boost
cancel_boost.description: Stop a running Boost; the room follows its schedule again.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: Hold the house at frost protection from the start until you are back. Each room starts warming up in time for your return.

cancel_vacation.name: Cancel vacation
cancel_vacation.description: End a manual vacation (calendar vacations follow the calendar).

return_in_past.message: The return moment must be in the future.

return_before_start.message: The return moment must be after the start of the vacation.

not_loaded.message: Smart Heating is not set up.
